Real Road Multi-Color Route Corridors: OSRM route segmentation dynamically colored by safety profiles with high-contrast outlines and danger zones
Continuous Real-Time GPS Tracking: Live continuous location tracking across SafeRoute, Explore radar, and Home telemetry pings
Verified Ground Truth Calibration: Ground-truth Google Maps coordinates and turn-by-turn directions across Rajam and Northern AP
